summary: P4 real-project end-to-end acceptance for alembic-plan-draft-pure-collection. With P0/P1/P2/P3 accepted, Test must prove on real BiliDili that the chain works as the requirement defines: new alembic_plan draft returns raw project facts and the full dimension/SOP catalog; an Agent authors a complete, project-fit Plan using only that raw draft payload (dimension choices, scale, module bindings, next actions, evidence/rationale); confirm persists it; get round-trips it; cold-start consumes the confirmed Plan as the no-guess precondition. The outcome must be a valuable, non-empty, project-fit Plan and cold-start evidence. Optional low-cost non-Swift project coverage may be added, but BiliDili is the required gate. Test must not modify product code or invent recommendation/top/rank/filter/scale-estimation behavior.

targetTasks.summary: Read parent AGENTS, active index/status, this state root, this task package, Test AGENTS, and the Design docs. Declare Test identity. Run P4 acceptance only. Use the current accepted Plugin/Core commits available in the workspace. On BiliDili, capture raw MCP/tool payloads or equivalent runtime JSON for draft, Agent-authored confirm payload, confirm result, get result, and cold-start/testMode result. Judge whether the Plan is valuable and project-fit from raw facts, not language-only or recommendation/top semantics: include chosen dimensions, why they fit BiliDili evidence, scale/budget, module bindings, evidence refs, and cold-start planGate consumption. Required evidence: command list and outputs/log summaries, raw payload/report paths, BiliDili git status before/after, exact Plugin/Core commits used, pass/fail conclusion, blockers with file:line if any. Forbidden: changing product code, accepting P4 based only on unit tests, using old active/skipped/recommended/top fields, or treating P3 controller smoke as P4 evidence.
